SELECT 
    fish_date_doy,
    cls,
    COUNT(*) as num_boats,
    SUM(yt) as total_yt,
    SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
    ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler,
    ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_boat
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 287 AND 303
  AND cls IN ('day_1_5', 'overnight')
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls;

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, boat, landing, COUNT(*) as count
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 244 AND 310
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls, boat, landing
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls, boat
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    fish_date_doy,
    cls,
    ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler,
    COUNT(*) as num_boats,
    ROUND(AVG(yt), 1) as avg_yt_per_boat
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 
  AND fish_date_doy >= 230
  AND cls IN ('day_1_5', 'overnight', 'three_quarter')
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls;

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as num_boats
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 244 AND 260
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls;
